svg.title: Central region profitability dashboard: $503,171 sales, $39,865 profit, 7.9% profit ratio, the lowest of the four regions.
svg.desc: Executive profitability overview for the Central region, orders from 1/3/2023 to 12/30/2026. Sales are $503,171 and profit $39,865, a 7.9% profit ratio with a 24.10% average discount on 8,820 items. Most states are profitable, but Texas and Illinois have a negative profit ratio, which keeps Central the least profitable region.
